Only same-chain deposit is admitted; no bridge, depositAndBridge, permit, refund-authority, manager or executor authority. HyperEVM yield exposure is not support for signing on HyperEVM.

deposit pulls only msg.sender ERC20 funds through vault.enter and mints hwUSD shares to msg.sender. Existing allowance must name the hwUSD vault 0xa2f8da4a55898b6c947fa392ef8d6bfd87a4ff77 as spender, not the teller. This capability grants no approval. Nonpayable: zero native value.

depositAmount is in deposit-token raw units; minimumMint and returned shares are raw vault share units. Shares floor depositAmount * 10**vault.decimals() / accountant.getRateInQuoteSafe(asset). The quote normalizes token decimals and can use configured rate providers; deposit can revert for unsupported assets, paused teller/accountant, zero amount or insufficient minimumMint.

Owner/authority can change supported assets, pricing configuration, share-lock period and strategy permissions. Public deposit updates shareUnlockTime and refundable-deposit history; locked shares can restrict transfers and an authorized refunder can reverse an eligible deposit by burning recipient shares and returning the recorded assets. No user refund permission is admitted.

Point-in-time Base reads observed isPaused=false, shareLockPeriod=0, public canCall for deposit=true, and supported USDC/USDe=true; these are not continuing availability promises. Current primary app explicitly enables hwUSD deposits on Base. Published product describes 10% performance fees and delayed redemption; this deposit interface has no deadline or guaranteed share price, principal, yield or immediate exit.

Hyperwave independently names and issues hwUSD using Boring Vault infrastructure; this is not another admission of the Veda protocol or a generic curator alias. Only the exact Base teller is inventoried; Ethereum/Arbitrum and HyperEVM financial or exit surfaces are not included.

depositAmount is in deposit-token raw units; minimumMint and returned shares are raw vault share units. Shares floor depositAmount * 10**vault.decimals() / accountant.getRateInQuoteSafe(asset). The quote normalizes token decimals and can use configured rate providers; deposit can revert for unsupported assets, paused teller/accountant, zero amount or insufficient minimumMint.

Owner/authority can change supported assets, pricing configuration, share-lock period and strategy permissions. Public deposit updates shareUnlockTime and refundable-deposit history; locked shares can restrict transfers and an authorized refunder can reverse an eligible deposit by burning recipient shares and returning the recorded assets. No user refund permission is admitted.

Point-in-time Base reads observed isPaused=false, shareLockPeriod=0, public canCall for deposit=true, and supported USDC/USDe=true; these are not continuing availability promises. Current primary app explicitly enables hwUSD deposits on Base. Published product describes 10% performance fees and delayed redemption; this deposit interface has no deadline or guaranteed share price, principal, yield or immediate exit.

Hyperwave independently names and issues hwUSD using Boring Vault infrastructure; this is not another admission of the Veda protocol or a generic curator alias. Only the exact Base teller is inventoried; Ethereum/Arbitrum and HyperEVM financial or exit surfaces are not included.
